name: io.github.apollographql/apollo-mcp-server
title: Apollo MCP Server
description: Exposes GraphQL operations and schema introspection from an Apollo GraphOS graph as MCP tools.

runtimeArguments.name: -e
runtimeArguments.description: Overrides the image default of streamable HTTP so the server speaks MCP over stdio.

runtimeArguments.name: -e
runtimeArguments.description: Passed with no value so Docker drops the image's bind-address default, which the stdio transport rejects.

runtimeArguments.name: -e
runtimeArguments.description: Sends logs to a file; without this the server writes them to stdout and corrupts the JSON-RPC stream.

runtimeArguments.name: -v
runtimeArguments.description: Mounts the server config file. The server requires a config path; its default argument is a placeholder.

config_file.description: Absolute path to your apollo-mcp-server YAML config file on the host.

packageArguments.description: Path to the config file inside the container.

environmentVariables.name: APOLLO_MCP_ENDPOINT
environmentVariables.description: URL of the GraphQL endpoint operations execute against. Overrides the config file.

environmentVariables.name: APOLLO_GRAPH_REF
environmentVariables.description: Apollo GraphOS graph reference (graph-id@variant); required when reading the schema or operations from GraphOS.

environmentVariables.name: APOLLO_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Apollo GraphOS API key used with APOLLO_GRAPH_REF.
